key_missing: No YouTube access code is registered.
key_refused: YouTube refuses the access code: “YouTube Data v3” must be enabled for it.
key_help: Free access code. In the [Google console](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/youtube.googleapis.com), enable “YouTube Data v3”. Then create an access code from the console menu, click “Register the access code” and paste it.
quota_exhausted: YouTube's daily allowance is used up. It restarts {when}.
acc_none: Used to answer in the chat, or if YouTube refuses to let it be read.
acc_step1: **Open the Google console** ([console.cloud.google.com](https://console.cloud.google.com/)). Choose or create a project, the same as for the YouTube access code if you have one. Check that “YouTube Data v3” is [enabled](https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/library/youtube.googleapis.com) there.
acc_step2: **Prepare the permission screen** in [Google Auth Platform](https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/overview). If Google offers “Get started”, write your site's name and your e-mail address, choose “External”, then finish. In “Audience”, click **Publish app**: without it, the connection stops after 7 days.
acc_step3: **Create the client**: in [Clients](https://console.cloud.google.com/auth/clients), click “Create client”. Choose the type **TVs and Limited Input devices** and give it a name, your site's name. Click “Create”. Google shows the client ID and the client secret: keep that window open.
acc_step4: **Paste them here**: click “Register the client ID” and paste the client ID and the client secret. The “Connect my YouTube account” button then appears.
acc_bad_id: The client ID does not look like what Google gives: it looks like 123456789-abcdef.apps.googleusercontent.com.
acc_bad_secret: The client secret looks incomplete: 8 characters at least, no spaces.
acc_stale: The client ID has changed since the last connection: connect your account again.
acc_need_write: “Answer in the chat” is on, but Google has not received the permission to write yet.
acc_pending: Finish on your phone to allow the reading of your live chat.
acc_pending_write: Finish on your phone: Google will also ask your permission to write in your chat.
pend_1: On your phone, open {url} (or scan the square next to it).
pend_2: Choose the YouTube account of your channel.
pend_4: Click “Continue”, then “Allow”. If Google says “unverified app”, it is your own app: click “Advanced”, then “Go to…”.
pend_5: Come back here and click “Done, check”. The code is valid for {minutes} more min.
pend_qr_alt: Square to scan to open google.com/device on the phone
check_done_write: YouTube account connected, with the permission to write in the chat.
check_pending: Google has not received your permission yet. Finish on your phone, then click again in {seconds} seconds.
disconnect_done: Account disconnected. Google has been told.
disconnect_local: Account disconnected here. Google did not answer: you can also remove the access at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
err_client_id: The client ID is missing or misspelled: fix it with “Edit the client ID”, then try again.
err_client_secret: The client secret is missing: add it with “Edit the client ID”, then try again.
err_too_fast: One moment: wait ten seconds before asking for a new code.
err_too_many: Too many code requests this hour. Try again in an hour.
err_client: Google refuses this client ID or secret. Check them, and that the client type is “TVs and Limited Input devices”.
err_scope: Google did not accept this permission. Check that “YouTube Data v3” is enabled, then start again leaving the YouTube permission ticked.
err_rate: Google asks for a pause. Try again in a few minutes.
err_timeout: Google is not answering. Try again in a few minutes.
err_network: Google is not answering. Try again in a few minutes.
err_google: Google answered something unexpected. Start again from the beginning.
err_no_pending: There is no code waiting any more. Click “Connect my YouTube account” to get a new one.
err_expired: The code has expired. Click “Connect my YouTube account” to get a new one.
err_denied: You refused the permission on Google: nothing is connected. Start again if it was a mistake.
err_policy: The chosen account cannot give this permission (a rule of its organisation at Google). Choose your channel's personal account.
last_code_expired: The code expired before it was used. Ask for a new one.
last_denied: You refused the permission on Google: nothing is connected.
last_policy: The chosen account cannot give this permission (a rule of its organisation at Google). Choose your channel's personal account.
last_client: Google refuses the client ID or the secret. Check them with “Edit the client ID”, then reconnect the account.
last_google: Google answered something unexpected. Start again from the beginning.
last_scope_missing: You unticked the permission on Google's screen: nothing is connected. Start again and leave the box ticked.
last_write_missing: Account connected, but Google did not grant the permission to write in the chat. Reconnect it, leaving the box ticked.
last_expired: Google has removed the account's access (removed from your Google account, or expired). Connect it again.
last_revoke_failed: Account disconnected here, but Google did not answer: you can also remove the access at myaccount.google.com/permissions.
key_forget_confirm: Forget the access code? It is deleted here. The YouTube extensions stop until you type one.
f_key_help: Free: create it on console.cloud.google.com (“YouTube Data v3”).
err_key: Paste the access code as Google shows it, without spaces, for example AIzaSyA1b2C3d4E5f6G7h8I9j0K1l2M3n4O5p6Q.
f_client_id_help: Created in the Google console: type “TVs and Limited Input devices”.
err_client_id_field: Write the client ID as Google shows it, for example 123456789-abcdef.apps.googleusercontent.com.
err_client_secret_field: Write the client secret as Google shows it: 8 characters at least, no spaces.
acc_summary_write: Connected since {date} · reads and answers in the chat
acc_summary_write_idle: Connected since {date} · reads the chat, answers off
disconnect_confirm: Disconnect the YouTube account? The site can no longer read the chat or answer in it with this account. Google is told.
